messages:
natalie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the 03/20 text-gen latency spike. We need concrete owners, timelines, and the SLO tweak proposal. I want this tracked before the next oncall rotation.

maya: Agreed. I'll draft the remediation checklist. Preliminary owners I'm thinking: liam -> batching/kv-cache fixes, sam -> dashboard + alerting, maya -> canary/rollout policy updates.

liam: Sounds good. Estimate for batching changes is ~2 weeks if nothing blocks. Will need a dev GPU for profiling. Can someone open a request?

sam: I'll own dashboards/alerts. Plan: add per-model p50/p90/p99 panels, throughput by shard, and an error-budget burn alert. Can add a synthetic transaction to smoke-test dashboards. Will try to get panels up in 2 business days.

natalie: Proposal for SLO change: current p99 = 350ms. Suggest temporary target p99 = 280ms for the text-gen public route, with a canary rollout for 48h and automatic rollback if error budget burn > 20% in 24h. Thoughts?

maya: +1 on canary. Also suggest creating an automatic fallback to smaller model variant if latency > 500ms for >5m. That reduces user-visible errors while we fix infra.

liam: Agree on fallback. For the quantization pipeline, I'll try a staged deploy with 10/30/100% traffic over a week. Adding owner and schedule to the issue now.

incident-bot: Created issue #4521: "postmortem/remediation/03-20-text-gen-latency" with template checklist and assignees.

sam: Draft alert (PromQL) for error budget burn (5m eval):
```
sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen",status!~"5.."}[1h])) / sum(increase(requests_total{route="text-gen"}[1h])) < 0.98
```
This flags client-visible degradation; will pair with a separate p99 spike alert.

maya: I added a runbook section under the issue: "high p99 with normal qps" steps, including quick mitigation: pause non-critical routing, enable fallback, and rollback model variant.

natalie: Nice. Can we put milestone dates in the issue? I propose: dashboards by 1987654400 (48h), alerts by 1987654400, batching PRs opened by 1987662400 (2 weeks), canary schedule and rollback policy by 1987658000 (5 days). Please update if that doesn't work.

liam: Milestones OK. I'll request a dev GPU in infra channel now.

sam: Will push dashboard JSON and screenshot attachments to the issue; pinging here when done.

maya: I'll own weekly check-ins on recurring incidents. Adding a cron in calendar for a 15m review for the next 3 weeks to watch the error budget trend.

natalie: Thanks everyone. Final ask: when you update the issue, add the explicit SLO change text and the rollback criteria. I'll sign off on the temporary SLO after those are in place. :thumbsup:
